Choose only an action listed in that exact parent row available_actions; unavailable_actions explains exclusions. refine_family preserves shared variables; refine_layers explicitly creates independent layer variables within original family bounds. Expectations are untested, not outcomes. No route or plan-count ceiling. Interpret measurements, local derivative arithmetic, and hypotheses separately. For a decreasing variable reverse the derivative sign; respect each goal sense and the supplied bounds. Local directional estimates do not establish finite-step outcomes or a unique mechanism. Explain why the chosen parent and action are informative; nearby parents need a reason, not a diversity quota. Exploratory actions, predicted tradeoffs, and unsuccessful hypotheses are legitimate; do not promise improvement. An empty plans list is allowed. Do not fabricate observations, material identities or new bounds.
